أتناوم (form VI)
# أَتَنَاوَمُ (ʔatanāwamu) /ʔa.ta.naː.wa.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَنَاوَمَ (tanāwama)
# أَتَنَاوَمَ (ʔatanāwama) /ʔa.ta.naː.wa.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاوَمَ (tanāwama)
# أَتَنَاوَمْ (ʔatanāwam) /ʔa.ta.naː.wam/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَنَاوَمَ (tanāwama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
